description: List conversion jobs created through the API, newest first. Filter by status or creation time. Returns up to `limit` jobs (default 25, max 100) and a `nextCursor`; pass it back as `cursor` to get the next page. `nextCursor` is null on the last page.

created_after.description: Only return jobs created after this ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

cursor.description: nextCursor from a previous list_conversions call.

status.description: Only return jobs with this status.

name: list_conversions
title: List conversion jobs
